name: Aurora Gradient UI
summary: Soft, blurred mesh gradients in 3 to 5 hues behind clean sans-serif type, with glowing edges and grain. It came from fintech and AI product pages and replaced the flat hero.

philosophy.core_thesis: Colour is atmosphere: a blurred field of light makes a product feel alive without any picture of it.
design_principles: Build the hero ground from 3 to 5 radial colour blobs of 400px to 900px, blurred by 80px to 160px, on a base of #0A0A14 or white.
Pick hues that sit within 90° to 150° on the colour wheel and keep saturation of 60% to 90%.
Add a grain overlay of 3% to 6% opacity at 1px to 2px noise to prevent banding.
Set headings in a clean sans at 56px to 96px, weight 500 to 600, and keep body text white at 80% opacity or ink on pale tints.
Outline cards with a 1px gradient border (white at 20% to 0%) and fill with white at 4% to 8%.
Animate the blobs: drift 40px to 120px over 12s to 30s, with ease-in-out and an alternate loop.
Limit the glow: one glow behind the hero object and one behind the primary button, each blur 24px to 60px at 30% to 50% opacity.
anti_patterns: Hard-edged linear gradients with visible bands
More than 5 hues in one field
Thick black borders and hard shadows
Fast, flashing gradient animation under 4s per loop

layout.grid_mechanics: A centred 12-column grid with 24px gutters; the hero spans the viewport, content sits in columns 3 to 10; colour blobs ignore the grid.
layout.whitespace_ratio: 35% to 50% of the surface stays empty; the spacing scale is 8, 16, 32, 64 and 128px.
layout.alignment_rules: Centred hero and flush-left sections; blobs bleed off the edges by 10% to 30%.
layout.container_geometry: Cards with a 16px to 24px radius, a 1px gradient border and a glass-like fill; pills at 999px for tags and buttons.

font_pairings.note: A modern geometric display with a neutral text face.
A soft geometric with clear numerals.

hierarchy_rules: Use three weights: regular (400), medium (500) and semibold (600).
Set body at 80% opacity of the text colour on dark grounds.

color.palette_structure: A dark or pale base with 3 to 5 blended hues.
color.contrast_rules: Text holds at least 12:1 on midnight; never place body text over a blob below 4.5:1.
color.surface_treatment: Blurred radial blobs over a dark base, with grain of 3% to 6%; no hard stops.
color.light_and_shadow: Light is colour: glows of 24px to 60px blur around key objects; no hard shadows.

materiality.surface_simulation: Light itself: a blurred gradient field with film grain.
materiality.border_rules: 1px gradient border from white at 20% to white at 0%.
materiality.blur_and_elevation: Blob blur 80px to 160px; glow blur 24px to 60px at 30% to 50%; cards have no shadow.

ornamentation_details.iconography: Thin 1.5px outline icons in white at 80% with round caps; glowing dot for status.
ornamentation_details.illustration: Abstract gradient fields, orbs and soft 3D shapes; product UI screenshots inside glass frames.

motion.transition_physics: Slow drift: the blobs move 40px to 120px over 12s to 30s; content fades up 12px in 500ms.
motion.hover_and_active: Hover raises the glow of a button by 20% and lifts it 2px; active state dims it by 10%.

emotion.target_response: The viewer feels a calm, futuristic glow and a sense of intelligence.

avoid_when: The brand must feel earthy, serious or print-like.
The page must print or run on low-power devices.
The audience needs high-contrast, plain reading.

modifiers.how: Replace the blobs by one flat accent and a white ground.
Add blur of 28px, a specular rim and capsule controls over the gradient.
Reduce the blobs to one faint glow and add hairlines and a mono face.

pack.why: A thin, round line that stays light on a glowing, blurred ground.

ground.why: Aurora interfaces put large soft lights of colour on a near-black sky.
